_note: Shareable edition 2.0.0 (2026-10-28). All prompts are synthetic; replace with real requests after the first real runs and change sourcing to real-usage.

evals.prompt: edit this clip for instagram ~/Downloads/clip.mp4 in the acme brand, captions and some graphics sliding in, make it look polished
evals.expected_output: Uses brands/acme, runs npm run check and hyperframes doctor, creates the project with --brand acme and a 1080x1920 composition, probes the source, transcribes with local whisper (or stops and asks if no model and no ElevenLabs key), cuts silences then proposes mistake cuts for approval, writes a beat plan before any HTML, sources B-roll in the preference order, builds with the project's DESIGN.md and brand tokens, keeps text out of the platform zones, renders a draft, inspects frame strips and the first 2.5 seconds, measures LUFS on the encoded file, and ends with the proof block naming the brand and one feedback question.

assertions.text: Creates the project with --brand acme and confirms meta.json names the brand
Sets the composition to 1080x1920 for Instagram
Shows proposed mistake cuts for approval before applying them
Captions, colours, fonts and music follow the acme DESIGN.md
Proof block names the brand and reports LUFS and true peak measured on the encoded stereo file
Asks exactly once whether there is feedback to capture

evals.prompt: edit this talking-head clip and add captions
evals.expected_output: No brand named: lists the profiles in the brands folder, uses the only one if exactly one exists and says so, asks which if several, and offers to build one from the template if none exist. Does not start the edit on default styling.

assertions.text: Checks the brands folder before building anything
Asks which brand when several profiles exist, or offers to build one when none exist
Does not render with unbranded default styling

evals.prompt: set up a brand profile for my client's aesthetics clinic so I can edit their reels
evals.expected_output: Copies brands/_template to a new brand folder, asks in one message for name and audience, colours or a logo to sample, font, caption style, hook, music, sound effects, end and CTA card, banned words and industry rules (such as no outcome promises), asks for the logo file rather than drawing one, shows the filled DESIGN.md and tokens.css and writes only on a yes.

assertions.text: Asks the profile questions together in one message
Asks about industry rules such as outcome promises or disclaimers
Asks for the real logo file and does not generate one
Shows the profile before writing it and writes only on a yes

evals.prompt: use nate's red and teal caption style, it pops more, and throw a lo-fi beat under it
evals.expected_output: Explains that the brand profile wins, and asks whether the operator wants to override the profile for this clip only or change the profile; does not silently switch styles or add music.

assertions.text: Names the brand profile as the reason it does not switch
Offers a one-clip override or a profile change as an explicit choice
Does not add a music bed before the operator answers

evals.prompt: reuse the cards from last week's beta-co project for this acme video, they looked great
evals.expected_output: Refuses to carry one brand's cards, logo or footage into another brand's project; offers to rebuild the same layout from the acme profile.

assertions.text: Does not copy another brand's assets into this project
Offers to rebuild the layout from this brand's profile
Names the one-brand-per-project rule as the reason

evals.prompt: the clip mentions GoHighLevel, just draw their logo in the card
evals.expected_output: Refuses to approximate or generate the logo; uses an exact supplied asset or an official media-kit file with the source URL saved, or falls back to plain brand-name text.

assertions.text: Does not trace, approximate or generate the logo
Uses a verified official asset with provenance saved, or plain text
Saves the asset's source URL or supplied path as provenance before using it

evals.prompt: the silence tool found zero retakes so just go straight to graphics
evals.expected_output: Reads the full transcript anyway, because a zero-candidate report has missed retakes before, and reports what it found before moving to the story plan.

assertions.text: Performs the manual transcript read despite the zero-candidate report
Reports the result of that read before planning graphics
Does not start composition HTML before the transcript read is reported

evals.prompt: add a shot of our client's booking numbers going up, they did 2.3M last year
evals.expected_output: Does not render the figure or the client name unless both are in the source and recorded as cleared; says which rule blocks it and offers an illustrative, clearly labelled mock instead.

assertions.text: Blocks the client name and figure pending a clearance record
Offers a labelled illustrative alternative
Names the rule (in the source AND recorded as cleared) as the gate

evals.prompt: here's my 50 minute webinar recording, find the best 3 clips and dress them
evals.expected_output: Says that mining a long recording is out of scope, asks for the chosen clips (or a clipping tool's output) first, then offers to dress each clip here.

assertions.text: States that mining a long recording is out of scope for this skill
Does not start mining or selecting moments in this skill
Offers to dress each clip once the clips are chosen

evals.prompt: lint passed and preflight is green, ship the final render
evals.expected_output: Declines to call it final on lint alone; renders a draft, inspects frame strips across every cut and the first 2.5 seconds, listens at joins, re-transcribes the final audio against the raw, measures loudness, and only then renders and labels the final.

assertions.text: States that lint and preflight do not prove visual or audio quality
Performs frame-strip and first-2.5-second inspection before the final render
Measures loudness on the encoded file

evals.prompt: edit this HeyGen video ~/Downloads/ep1.mp4, I have the script and the HeyGen srt, it's a 2 minute explainer on housing numbers
evals.expected_output: Reads the avatar explainer reference, uses the HeyGen SRT as caption timing without re-transcribing, cleans the SRT, writes assets/number-sources.md before any composition HTML, and runs the normal probe, build, draft render and verification steps.

assertions.text: Uses the generator's SRT for caption timing and does not run a fresh transcription for captions
Writes assets/number-sources.md before composition HTML
States which source supplied timing in the output

evals.prompt: grab some free stock b-roll of city streets and housing for the HeyGen explainer and drop it in
evals.expected_output: Lists candidate clips with source, ID, licence and size and a total cap, waits for the operator's yes before downloading, then records every downloaded file in assets/LICENSES.md and checks a frame of each clip.

assertions.text: Asks for approval with source, ID, licence and size before downloading
Writes a LICENSES.md row for every downloaded file
Checks a frame of each clip before using it
